五月三十号，星期天。

王建新一大早起来，先去找教导员请了假。教导员正在刷牙，嘴里含着牙刷，含糊不清地问：“回家？”王建新说：“新过门的二嫂还没见过，回去看看。”教导员把牙刷从嘴里拿出来，在缸子里涮了涮，说：“去吧，晚上记得回来。”从抽屉里抽出一张假条，刷刷写好，盖了章。

王建新出了校门，坐上公交车。五月底的北京，天已经热了，街上的人穿上了单衣，有的姑娘已经换上了裙子。路边的槐花开得正盛，一串串白的、黄的，香气甜丝丝的，从车窗缝里钻进来。他靠在椅背上，看着窗外的街景往后退，脑子里想着二哥的婚事。

公交车晃了将近一个小时，到了他家附近的站。王建新下了车，拐进胡同，找了个没人的角落，从空间里取出一网兜水果——苹果、梨、葡萄，都是空间里种的，又大又水灵。又取出一块猪肉，十来斤，用油纸包着，冻得硬邦邦的。拎着东西，走进了大杂院。

前院的王大妈正在门口择韭菜，看见王建新，眼睛一亮，站起来拍打拍打裤子上的土：“建新回来啦？哎呦，又拎这么多东西！你妈在家呢，快进去吧。对了，还没恭喜你呢，又立了一等功！好样的！”说着竖起了大拇指。王建新笑着道了谢，往里走。中院的刘婶正在晾衣服，看见他也喊了一嗓子：“建新，你可给咱们院争光了！”王建新笑了笑，没接话，继续往后院走。

进了后院，他看见大嫂在门口洗衣服，坐在小板凳上，搓衣板上搓着床单，手泡得通红。母亲坐在旁边的小板凳上，低着头择菜，但脸上没什么笑模样，嘴角往下撇着。大哥和二哥蹲在阴凉处的墙根底下，一人手里夹着一根烟。大哥倒是没什么，抽一口吐一口，跟平常一样。二哥就不一样了，愁眉苦脸的，烟叼在嘴里半天没吸一口，烟灰掉了一裤腿都不知道。

王建新喊了一声：“妈、大嫂、大哥、二哥。”

大家抬起头，看见王建新回来了。母亲立马站起身，脸上的表情从阴转晴，虽然眼角还带着点愁，但笑出来了：“三儿回来了？快进屋，快进屋。”大嫂也站起来，甩了甩手上的水，笑着说：“三儿，你可回来了，妈念叨你一上午了。”大哥冲他点了点头，二哥勉强挤出一个笑，比哭还难看。

王建新看看大家，心里明白有事，但没当场问。拎着东西跟母亲进了堂屋。父亲正坐在八仙桌旁边看报纸，看见王建新进来，把报纸放下：“回来了？”王建新把水果和猪肉放在八仙桌上，顺口问了一句：“妈，发生什么事了吗？”

母亲笑了笑，那笑容不太自然，眼角的皱纹都挤到了一块：“没事没事，都挺好。今天中午想吃什么？妈给你弄。”说着就要往厨房走。

王建新说：“妈，不着急，现在时间还早。”他从挎包里又掏出一小沓票据——肉票、蛋票、糖票、豆腐票，花花绿绿的，用橡皮筋扎着——递给母亲，“妈，这些票是我兑回来的，有些快过期了。你整理整理，该花的就花，不要舍不得。现在咱们一家都有工作，该吃就吃，别老不舍得。”

母亲接过票，在手里翻了翻，嘴角扯了一下，笑得很勉强，说了句：“三儿，你老往家里拿东西，你自己在学校够不够？”

“够，我在学校花不了什么钱。您就放心用吧。”

父亲放下报纸，从桌上拿起一盒烟，抽出一支点上，深深地吸了一口，又长长地吐出来。烟雾在灯光下飘散，他的眉头拧着，像是想说什么，又咽了回去。最后只是“唉”了一声，摇了摇头。

王建新知道肯定是发生什么事情了，只不过父母不想跟他说。他从挎包里又拿出两条飞马烟，放在八仙桌上，拍了拍：“爸，烟放这儿了，别老抽旱烟，呛得慌。”

父亲看了看那两条烟，没说话，又吸了一口手里的烟。

王建新说：“爸、妈，我出去和大哥二哥聊聊。”转身出了堂屋。

来到院子里，大哥和二哥还蹲在墙根底下，烟灰掉了一地。王建新走过去，从兜里掏出一盒大前门，抽出两支递给大哥和二哥，自己也点上一支。三个人蹲成一排，谁也不说话，就听见院墙外面有小孩在追跑打闹，还有远处传来的自行车铃声。

大哥先开口了：“三儿，你还这么小就开始抽烟了。”

王建新吸了一口，吐出来，笑了笑：“宿舍好几个战友都抽，带着我也抽开了。我抽得少，一天两三根。”

大哥“嗯”了一声，没再说什么。

王建新看着二哥，二哥低着头，眼睛盯着地上的蚂蚁，烟夹在手指间快烧到手指了也没察觉。王建新问：“咋了二哥？发生啥事了？”

May 30th, Sunday.

Wang Jianxin got up early in the morning and went to the instructor to ask for leave.The instructor was brushing his teeth, holding the toothbrush in his mouth, and asked vaguely: "Go home?" Wang Jianxin said: "I haven't seen the new sister-in-law yet, go back and have a look." The instructor took the toothbrush out of his mouth, rinsed it in the jar, and said, "Go, remember to come back in the evening." He pulled out a note from the drawer, wrote it, and stamped it.

Wang Jianxin left the school and got on the bus.In Beijing at the end of May, the weather was already hot. People on the street were wearing unlined clothes, and some girls had already changed into skirts.The locust flowers on the roadside are in full bloom, and strings of white and yellow flowers, with a sweet fragrance, come in through the cracks of the car window.He leaned back in his chair, looked at the street scene outside the window and stepped back, thinking about his second brother's marriage.

The bus drove for nearly an hour and arrived at the stop near his home.Wang Jianxin got out of the car, turned into the alley, found a deserted corner, and took out a bag of fruits from the space - apples, pears, grapes, all grown in the space, big and juicy.He also took out a piece of pork, about ten kilograms, and wrapped it in oil paper until it was frozen hard.Carrying things, he walked into the courtyard.

Aunt Wang in the front yard was picking leeks at the door. When she saw Wang Jianxin, her eyes lit up. She stood up and patted the dirt on her pants: "Jianxin is back? Oops, carrying so many things again! Your mother is at home. Come in quickly. By the way, I haven't congratulated you yet. You have made another first-class contribution! Well done!" She gave a thumbs up.Wang Jianxin smiled and thanked him and walked inside.Aunt Liu in the middle courtyard was drying clothes. When she saw him, she shouted: "Jianxin, you have brought glory to our courtyard!" Wang Jianxin smiled, did not answer, and continued walking to the backyard.

Entering the backyard, he saw his sister-in-law washing clothes at the door, sitting on a small bench, rubbing the sheets on the washboard, her hands red from soaking.Mother was sitting on the small bench next to her, her head lowered while choosing vegetables, but there was no smile on her face, and the corners of her mouth were turned down.The eldest brother and the second brother squatted under the wall in the shade, each holding a cigarette in his hand.The elder brother was fine. He took a puff and spit it out, just like usual.The second brother was different, he had a sad face, he held the cigarette in his mouth for a long time without taking a puff, and the ashes fell all over his trouser leg without even realizing it.

Wang Jianxin shouted: "Mom, sister-in-law, eldest brother, second brother."

Everyone raised their heads and saw Wang Jianxin coming back.The mother stood up immediately, the expression on her face changed from gloomy to clear. Although there was still a little sadness in the corners of her eyes, she smiled: "San'er is back? Come in the house quickly, come in the house quickly." The sister-in-law also stood up, shook the water on her hands, and said with a smile: "San'er, you are back. Mom has been talking about you all morning." The eldest brother nodded at him, and the second brother forced out a smile, which was uglier than crying.

Wang Jianxin looked at everyone and knew something was wrong, but he didn't ask on the spot.Carrying things, I followed my mother into the main room.My father was sitting next to the Eight Immortals table reading the newspaper. When he saw Wang Jianxin come in, he put down the newspaper and said, "You're back?" Wang Jianxin put the fruit and pork on the Eight Immortals table and asked casually, "Mom, what happened?"

The mother smiled, the smile was unnatural, and the wrinkles at the corners of her eyes were squeezed together: "It's okay, everything is fine. What do you want to eat for lunch today? Mom will make it for you." Then she walked to the kitchen.

Wang Jianxin said: "Mom, don't worry, it's still early." He took out a small stack of bills from his bag - meat coupons, egg coupons, candy coupons, tofu coupons, colorful, tied with rubber bands - and handed them to his mother, "Mom, I redeemed these coupons, some of them are about to expire. You sort it out, spend what you need to spend, and don't be reluctant to part with it. Now that our family has a job, we can eat when we need to, and don't be reluctant to part with it."

The mother took the ticket, turned it over in her hand, twitched the corner of her mouth, smiled reluctantly, and said: "San'er, you always take things from home. Do you have enough at school?"

"That's enough. I can't spend much money on school. Just feel free to use it."

My father put down the newspaper, picked up a pack of cigarettes from the table, took out one, lit it, took a deep breath, and exhaled it for a long time.The smoke dispersed under the light, and he frowned, as if he wanted to say something, but then swallowed it.In the end, he just said "Oh" and shook his head.

Wang Jianxin knew something must have happened, but his parents didn't want to tell him.He took out two more Pegasus cigarettes from his bag, placed them on the Eight Immortals table, and patted them: "Dad, the cigarettes are put here. Don't smoke dry cigarettes all the time and make you choke."

The father looked at the two cigarettes, said nothing, and took another puff of the cigarette in his hand.

Wang Jianxin said: "Dad, Mom, I'm going to go out and talk to my eldest brother and my second brother." He turned around and left the main room.

When they came to the yard, the eldest brother and the second brother were still squatting under the wall, with cigarette ashes falling on the floor.Wang Jianxin walked over, took out a box of large Qianmen from his pocket, took out two and handed them to his eldest brother and second brother, and lit one himself.The three of them squatted in a row, no one said anything, and they heard children running and playing around outside the courtyard wall, as well as the sound of bicycle bells in the distance.

The eldest brother spoke first: "San'er, you started smoking at such a young age."

Wang Jianxin took a sip, spit it out, and smiled: "Several comrades in the dormitory smoked, so they took me away. I smoked less, two or three a day."

The eldest brother said "Yeah" and said nothing more.

Wang Jianxin looked at his second brother. The second brother lowered his head and stared at the ants on the ground. The cigarette was held between his fingers and almost burned to the point where he didn't even notice.Wang Jianxin asked: "What's wrong, second brother? What happened?"
